extensions.scope: The manifold-observations lane at q = 8, 13, 21, 34 (produced on an r7i.16xlarge with exact between-count profiles at every level): Myrheim-Meyer dimension on interior diamonds of three sizes at the centre and at up to sixteen off-centre tips, moving-tip diamonds at four rapidities, interval-abundance profiles against fixed-count sprinklings of flat diamonds in 3+1 and 2+1 dimensions, the Benincasa-Dowker action, link-direction multipoles against a uniform reference, and count clocks, all from the event order and cardinalities alone. Readings at q = 34: dimension 4.10 at the centre (six layers), the same reading to within 0.03 at every off-centre tip of the same size; moving-tip diamonds at tip separations 0.23 to 0.81 of T read ordering fractions 0.108 to 0.125 (dimensions 3.73 to 3.92) against 0.145 for the five-layer vertical diamond; the abundance of intervals of 64 to 1024 events matches the sprinkling within 14 percent while links are 23 percent of related pairs against 8.6 percent for the sprinkling; the odd link multipoles vanish and the l = 4 power falls 0.036, 0.023, 0.0060, 0.0016 over the four levels; the two- and one-dimensional controls read 3.01 and 2.00.
extensions.nonclaims: the family is a layered order, not a sprinkling: links, small intervals and the Benincasa-Dowker action read the lattice scale and are reported as controls; sprinklings are imported comparison controls; no physical clock, spacetime, curvature or continuum limit; the Hawking-King-McCarthy and Malament statements are declared citations, not computed
extensions.verifier: check_manifold_observations checks the generator pin, the scope flags, every centre diamond's event and pair counts against the exact family receipt, the dimension inversions, the abundance ratios, the action arithmetic, the link count against the edge count, the vanishing odd multipoles and the trend rows
